Name: Iddo, the Seer
Summary: Iddo the seer recorded visions against Jeroboam son of Nebat, wrote concerning the genealogies of Rehoboam's days, and wrote the story of Abijah.
KeyStory: Solomon's acts are written in the visions of Iddo the seer, Rehoboam's acts in the book of Iddo concerning genealogies, and Abijah's ways in the story of the prophet Iddo.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Rehoboam; Abijah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Faithful record-keeping preserves God's dealings for generations who were not there.
